items.title: Bernard Purdie interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: I came in because they couldn’t find another drummer. They went around looking. This was a demo.

ctx.x: It was a straight, you know? I mean we had no strings and horns and stuff like that. We had background singers. And I came in because they couldn’t find another drummer. They went around looking. This was a demo.
